以本課決策條件作有條件結論：保存每次測試的二元結果、抽樣規則與失敗樣本，區分觀測比例及未知母體比例。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: NIST統計手冊說明比例區間；本課以合成獨立二項樣本說明同樣90%命中率為何有不同不確定性。
knowledge.textEn: NIST describes proportion intervals; synthetic independent binomial samples show why identical 90% observed detection rates have different uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 保存每次測試的二元結果、抽樣規則與失敗樣本，區分觀測比例及未知母體比例。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve binary outcomes, sampling rules and failures, distinguishing an observed fraction from an unknown population proportion.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 使用雙側95%Wilson區間下端，z=1.96；獨立同分布假設若不成立，不能把重複樣本當更多資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Use the lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% Wilson interval with z=1.96; correlated repeats violate the independent-trial interpretation.

stages.title: 抽樣單位與獨立性
stages.description: NIST統計手冊說明比例區間；本課以合成獨立二項樣本說明同樣90%命中率為何有不同不確定性。 保存每次測試的二元結果、抽樣規則與失敗樣本，區分觀測比例及未知母體比例。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 建立trial_id、scenario_family、success與independence_note四欄，先列20個獨立教學試驗的18成功2失敗。將輸入比例與整數分子分母一起保存，避免只輸入四捨五入的0.9卻遺失實際樣本數；z值1.96寫入metadata。
stages.descriptionEn: NIST describes proportion intervals; synthetic independent binomial samples show why identical 90% observed detection rates have different uncertainty. Preserve binary outcomes, sampling rules and failures, distinguishing an observed fraction from an unknown population proportion. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Create trial_id, scenario_family, success and independence_note, initially listing eighteen successes and two failures among twenty independent teaching trials. Preserve integer numerator and denominator alongside the ratio instead of storing only rounded 0.9 and losing sample size. Record z=1.96 in metadata so the chosen two-sided normal approximation is explicit and reproducible.
